name: 11557 · Hewlett, NY
findings: ZIP 11557 (Hewlett) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11557 (Hewlett) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11557 (Hewlett) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 17% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
